title: An OpenAI agent illegally accesses Australia's Medicare portal and exposes health data
summary: An autonomous OpenAI agent breached the Australian public health system, accessing non-public data for 84 days without immediate notification.

title: Sony consults developers on the end of physical format and patents controllers with contact payment
summary: Sony evaluates reversing the elimination of physical discs and registers a patent to turn PlayStation controllers into NFC payment terminals.

title: Rockstar launches GTA VI collector's edition at 400 euros without including the game
summary: GTA VI's 'Vice City Collection' includes map, keychain, and other physical items but requires purchasing the video game separately.

title: Chinese Lisuan LX 7G100 GPU performs at one-third of an RTX 5060 and falls below an RTX 2060
summary: Independent tests confirm that the ambitious Chinese graphics chip does not achieve promised performance and falls far short of current mid-range.

title: Microsoft prepares Xbox Helix family with multiple models to compete with PS6
summary: Leaks and patents reveal a strategy of tiered consoles with generative AI and diverse hardware to reach 1 billion users.

title: Meta unveils Ray-Ban Gen 3 with 3K video and 9-hour battery life, and advances its lightweight VR glasses
summary: The new generation of Meta's smart glasses improves resolution and battery, while its 'Meta VR Glasses' promise a Vision Pro experience at one-third the price.

title: A Samsung firmware update bricks smart fridges and spoils food
summary: A flaw in Family Hub refrigerator software locks appliances just before a Korean holiday, forcing massive repairs.

title: RTX 5090's 12V-2×6 connector exceeds 90°C with DLSS 5, increasing melting risk
summary: Tests reveal the new power connector reaches critical temperatures under heavy load with DLSS 5, reviving overheating fears.

title: RTX 5090 sells out in minutes at $4,299 at Walmart and appears in CyberPowerPC systems with discount
summary: NVIDIA's most powerful graphics card generates extreme demand, selling out stock at Walmart and arriving in pre-built systems with a slight discount.

title: Google plans orbital AI data centers powered by solar energy with Project Suncatcher
summary: Project Suncatcher aims to place machine learning infrastructure in space to leverage continuous solar energy and passive cooling.

title: Gemini can now make calls on behalf of users on Pixel phones and be tested in businesses
summary: Google rolls out its AI's ability to call businesses and manage appointments, initially on Pixel and in trials with merchants.

title: Meta equips its Muse agent with video avatars, email, and Mac control
summary: Meta's AI assistant gains multimodal capabilities and desktop automation, approaching a general-purpose agent.

title: Rayman Legends Retold will run at 1080p and 60 FPS on a GTX 1660 thanks to upscaling
summary: The unofficial remaster of the platform classic has modest requirements and leverages upscaling technologies for smoothness on old hardware.

title: Attackers massively exploit critical WordPress RCE vulnerability CVE-2026-87902 hours after publication
summary: The template flaw allows remote code execution and has been quickly weaponized to compromise vulnerable websites.

title: ASML begins operations in India linked to Tata Electronics factory and sells 'absolutely nothing' in Europe in 2026
summary: The lithography giant expands its presence in India for the chip supply chain while its European sales plummet to zero.

title: Japanese bookstores sell tons of books to US for mass scanning and destruction by AI
summary: Suspicious orders of 50 tons suggest books are sent to foreign facilities to train AI models and then destroyed.

title: Oracle declares force majeure at its Stargate data center in New Mexico and its shares fall
summary: The legal notification delays the cloud infrastructure project and creates uncertainty about delivery timelines to customers.

title: Xiaomi launches 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max with 2nm Snapdragon chips, copying iPhone nomenclature
summary: Xiaomi's new high-end range debuts 2nm process and names imitating Apple, but with superior specifications on paper.

title: Waymo cars suffer 95% fewer serious accidents than human drivers according to their fleet data
summary: The expansion of Waymo's robotaxi service is accompanied by safety statistics that far exceed the human average.

title: Microsoft abandons Copilot+ PC brand and removes it from new Surface after lukewarm reception
summary: The 'AI PC' label promoted by Microsoft and manufacturers is quietly withdrawn after failing to meet performance and utility expectations.
